mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate indicates tighter monetary policy, which can lead to decreased borrowing and spending, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 shows positive 20-day returns when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: Increasing housing starts indicate strong consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by 5% in one month
failure_condition: Negative S&P 500 returns despite a 5% increase in HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment rates signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.

candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by 1% and UNRATE decreases by 0.2%
failure_condition: Positive S&P 500 returns despite the trigger conditions.
